entities.name: Query protein 588 aa
observations: Sequence length is 588 aa; estimated molecular mass is 63.6 kDa and theoretical pI is 6.34.
The N-terminal residues 32–354 align to bacterial GLPX/fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase class 2 proteins at approximately 36–41% identity over about 323–350 residues.
The query is longer than the curated GLPX references, so full-length functional equivalence is not established.

entities.name: P0A9C9 FBPase class 2
observations: Reviewed Escherichia coli fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase class 2 (GLPX) annotation.
Catalyzes hydrolysis of fructose 1,6-bisphosphate to fructose 6-phosphate and inorganic phosphate; EC 3.1.3.11; Rhea RHEA:11064.
Requires Mn2+; Mg2+, Co2+, Ni2+, Ca2+, Cu2+, and Zn2+ do not support activity in the curated annotation.
Cytoplasmic homodimer involved in gluconeogenesis, especially growth on glycerol.

entities.name: Fructose-1,6-bisphosphate hydrolysis
observations: Curated reaction: beta-D-fructose 1,6-bisphosphate + H2O = beta-D-fructose 6-phosphate + phosphate.
The reaction is assigned to EC 3.1.3.11 and Rhea RHEA:11064 for the reference GLPX protein.
